title: Deeper RenderPreset object-graph boundary for standalone PLOTSETTINGS
mode: official API/DXF reference and independent open-source source review
question: Can PLOTSETTINGS shade mode RenderPreset (5) be emitted by following a uniquely typed and remapped code-333 RenderSettings reference?

sources.finding: Shade mode 5 is RenderPreset and distinct from VisualStyle mode 4.
RenderPreset mode requires a valid RenderSettings object ID; this API contract does not identify the saved standalone PLOTSETTINGS dictionary route.
The RenderSettings class documentation describes ACAD_RENDER_SETTINGS for custom settings and ACAD_RENDER_ACTIVE_SETTINGS for the active object.

Pre-2016 custom MentalRay presets use ACAD_RENDER_SETTINGS; ACAD_RENDER_PLOT_SETTINGS stores a copy for assignment to a Viewport or PlotSettings. Newer RapidRT presets use ACAD_RENDER_RAPIDRT_SETTINGS.
MENTALRAYRENDERSETTINGS has a DXF object record with handle and owner-dictionary links; Autodesk marks the feature unavailable in 2016+ products but retains the data for compatibility.
RAPIDRTRENDERSETTINGS has a DXF record with handle and owner-dictionary links and versioned subclass fields.

The current RapidRT Viewport example resolves ACAD_RENDER_RAPIDRT_SETTINGS and assigns the RapidRTRenderSettings object ID to Viewport.SetShadePlot; this is not a standalone PLOTSETTINGS wire example.
LibreDWG maps RAPIDRTRENDERSETTINGS, MENTALRAYRENDERSETTINGS, and RENDERSETTINGS as separate DXF object families.
LibreDWG labels these renderer settings objects unstable; availability in its implementation does not qualify semantic preservation.

conclusion.implementationDisposition: Keep shade mode 5 rejected. A Viewport ObjectARX sample and a general RenderSettings ObjectId contract do not prove the standalone PLOTSETTINGS code-333 target/root relationship. Require version-specific primary DXF wire evidence or native save/readback before adding a route.

implementationReadiness: Create a version-keyed route matrix for code 333 object family, root dictionary, owner and entry key, source callback/raw carrier, wire schema, and writer/readback.
Resolve the modern RapidRT question of global ACAD_RENDER_RAPIDRT_SETTINGS versus ACAD_RENDER_PLOT_SETTINGS copy for standalone PLOTSETTINGS, separately from Viewport usage.
Resolve the legacy MENTALRAY path separately; do not combine it with RapidRT based only on the common RenderSettings base class.

After evidence closes a route, add a focused ASCII/Binary generated graph with wrong-family, wrong-root, wrong-owner, unresolved, duplicate and collision controls; retain fail-closed behavior for all other versions.
